recipe.name: Amaro Margarita
directions:
Rim the edge of a glass with salt, fill with ice, and set aside. Add all of the ingredients to a shaker with ice and shake vigorously. Strain into the prepared glass, then add the garnish.
Rich Cinnamon SyrupSlice 6 cinnamon sticks thinly lengthwise to expose more surface area for more flavor. Add 9 oz. of demerara sugar to 6 oz. of boiling water, stir, and allow the sugar to dissolve completely. Add the cinnamon and allow to steep overnight. Strain out the cinnamon sticks. Will keep for about a month in the refrigerator.
